svg.title: British Columbia / Parks Branch — dogwood cap badge
svg.desc: Clean designed reconstruction of the photographed badge. Smooth geometry and outlined type replace all image-derived contours. Relief, hammered grain, ageing, reflections and display stands are omitted. Exact original typeface, die engraving and material tones cannot be authenticated; the few silver/bronze fills are a material interpretation. The cap-badge scroll family is shared, with a separate dogwood, simplified framed arms or full-arms centre. Petal relief and small engraved lettering are idealized.
